_note: Per-school decisions for scripts/harvest-school-logos.mjs, each from a look at the site (2026-10-05). selector = the exact logo element (it may be a text wordmark); url = the school's own logo file (or, where its site refuses every automated request, the logo it registers on Wikidata, rendered to PNG by Wikimedia); crop = fractions of the image to keep; use 'icon' = the site's square app icon is the logo; 'favicon' = the site refuses automated browsers, so its icon via Google's favicon service (kept only at >= 64px); 'none' = no logo could be found that is the school's own, so the page shows the monogram.

abc-english.why: the homepage script fails before the logo renders; this is its own logo file — over http because the site serves no https (checked 2026-10-05), and the tile was checked by eye

viet-nam-tinh-hoa-the-futures-school.why: the logo its own JSON-LD declares; the header image is a strip of partner logos

a-chau-english.why: the header capture picked up a stray mark; this is the site's own logo file

saigon-south-international-school.why: the logo its own JSON-LD declares; the header logo is not an image the picker can see; the file is the white logo, so it sits on SSIS navy

vietnam-australia-international-school.why: vas.edu.vn answers 403 to every automated request and its favicon is 16px

british-council.why: britishcouncil.vn and .org refuse the connection (HTTP/2 reset); this is the logo Wikidata Q45433 lists (P154), public domain on Commons

gems-english-center.why: the site (last updated 2017) shows no logo

uk-academy-binh-thanh.why: no logo image the picker can find; its icon is the UK Academy crest

curioo-vietnam.why: the logo is a text wordmark

vus-the-english-center.why: vus.edu.vn answers 401/502 to automated requests; its 256px icon is the VUS mark

i-can-read-vietnam.why: the homepage never settles for a capture; its icon is the I Can Read mark

ton-duc-thang-university.why: the header capture came out dimmed under a pop-up backdrop; this is the site's own large logo; white tile on purpose: the mark sits in its own white disc

einstein-school-hcm.why: the header image pairs the ESH logo with a Cognia accreditation badge — kept: the ESH half, on the header's plum

saigon-international-university.why: the header shows a small white-text variant; this is the full-colour logo from the same site

european-international-school-ho-chi-min.why: the header capture is the white logo over a photo; this is the colour version the site also serves (an SVG, drawn to PNG)

ismart-education.why: the header shows the logo beside a 15-years anniversary banner; keep only the iSMART logo
